Formats

UGC ads that sound like a creator, not a brand deck.

This is what ‘directed, not just sourced’ looks like on a feed: the formats we build, and sample tiles showing how a hook, a creator and a format come together. The brand names below are invented. We are new, and we would rather show the shape of the work than borrow someone else's logo.

  • Hooks and ads

    The first three seconds decide everything, so that is where we spend most of our energy. We script, cast and shoot scroll-stopping hooks built for feed placement, not just brand safety.

    • Hook testing
    • Feed-first
    • TikTok and Reels

  • Testimonials

    Real people, real phones, real opinions, just aimed properly. We brief creators like actors, not customers, so the review still feels unscripted where it counts.

    • Social proof
    • UGC
    • Conversion

  • Founder-led

    Sometimes the best spokesperson is the person who built the thing. We direct founders through the same process as the roster, hooks, retakes and all, so they do not have to wing it on camera.

    • Founder voice
    • Authenticity
    • Brand story

  • Trends and sounds

    We track what is actually moving on the app this week, not last quarter's trend report. Then we brief creators to bend it around your product instead of bolting your logo onto someone else's meme.

    • Trend-led
    • Sound strategy
    • Timely

  • Whitelisting

    Your best-performing organic content, running as paid from the creator's own handle. We handle the usage rights and the Spark Ads setup so the ad keeps the creator's credibility intact.

    • Spark Ads
    • Usage rights
    • Paid social

  • Scripts and edits

    Every video starts as a proper script, not a vague vibe brief, and ends with an edit built for the platform it is going on. Same team end to end, so nothing gets lost in translation.

    • Scriptwriting
    • Editing
    • Platform-native
